transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the weekly training synchronization. I'll go around the room for roster, qualification, scheduling, and facility updates before I publish next week's schedule. As a reminder, the draft has Transport Section vehicle-recovery training on Tuesday 0900 to 1100 and Generator Section load-bank training on Wednesday 0900 to 1100. Who wants to start with their updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, my roster audit completed this morning shows that exactly five of the eight Transport operators lack current vehicle-recovery-equipment qualification and must attend the recertification block. The other three are already qualified. I should note that the updated roster has not yet been entered in the training tracker, so I'll make sure that gets updated today.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a facility conflict. I confirmed this morning that the Generator Training Pad is reserved for calibration work on Wednesday from 0900 to 1300, so the Generator Section's load-bank session cannot use that pad on Wednesday. It needs to be moved to Monday from 1300 to 1500. I should note that the facility calendar still shows the recurring Wednesday slot, so it hasn't been updated yet to reflect the calibration reservation.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Enter the updated Transport Section roster into the training tracker today to reflect the five operators requiring recertification.
Update the facility calendar to reflect the calibration reservation on Wednesday 0900-1300 and the Generator load-bank training moved to Monday 1300-1500.
